import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { DiagnosisProvider, Header, Footer } from '@/components/namae';
import './globals.css';
const title='NAMAE｜もし海外で生まれていたらあなたは何という名前？';
const description='日本での名前や苗字ランキングをもとに、日本と同じ順位の海外の名前へ変換する診断サービス。日本と海外5か国の公開データに対応。';
export const metadata: Metadata = {metadataBase:new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'),title,description,openGraph:{title,description,type:'website',locale:'ja_JP',siteName:'NAMAE'},twitter:{card:'summary_large_image',title,description}};
export default function RootLayout({children}:Readonly<{children:React.ReactNode}>) {return <html lang="ja"><body><DiagnosisProvider><div className="site-shell"><Header/>{children}<Footer/></div></DiagnosisProvider></body></html>;}

"use client";
import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
function Flag({ code, label }: { code: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <Image
      className="country-flag"
      src={`/flags/${code}.svg`}
      width={36}
      height={36}
      alt={label}
      unoptimized
    />
  );
}
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
  type FormEvent,
} from "react";
import {
  diagnose,
  getCountryConfig,
  getNameRecord,
  getReadingOptions,
  getSurnameRecord,
} from "@/lib/engine";
import { saveResult, shareResult } from "@/lib/share";
import type { Diagnosis, Gender, NameType } from "@/lib/types";
const ResultContext = createContext<{
  result: Diagnosis | null;
  setResult: (value: Diagnosis) => void;
}>({ result: null, setResult: () => {} });
export function DiagnosisProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<Diagnosis | null>(null);
  return (
    <ResultContext.Provider value={{ result, setResult }}>
      {children}
    </ResultContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function Home({

  return (

      <main className="home">

        </section>
        <section className="form-column">
          <div className="form-topline">

        </section>
      </main>
      <section id="how" className="how">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">HOW IT WORKS</span>

            <br />
            もうひとつの世界。
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div>

          <h3>あなたの名前を教えて</h3>
          <p className="record-meta">
            下の名前、または苗字を入力。

            登録なし、無料で楽しめます。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="step-number">02</span>
          <h3>同じ人気度でつながる</h3>
          <p>
            各国のランキングから、
            <br />
            日本と同じ順位の名前を探します。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="step-number">03</span>

          <p>
            結果をストーリーサイズで保存。
            <br />
            友達の名前も、見てみよう。
          </p>

      </section>
      <p className="data-note">
                日本と海外5か国の公開ランキングと名前辞書で診断します。出典は結果で確認できます。

function NameForm({ initialType }: { initialType: NameType }) {
  const [type, setType] = useState(initialType);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<Gender>("male");
  const [reading, setReading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const { setResult } = useContext(ResultContext);
  const router = useRouter();
  function submit(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const input = {
        name,
        type,
        ...(type === "given_name"
          ? { gender, ...(reading ? { reading } : {}) }
          : {}),
      };
      const surnameRecord =
        type === "given_name" &&
        !getNameRecord(input) &&
        getSurnameRecord(name);
      const result = surnameRecord
        ? {
            ...diagnose({ name, type: "surname" }),
            autoDetectedFrom: "given_name" as const,
          }
        : diagnose(input);
      setResult(result);
      router.push("/result");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        e instanceof Error
          ? e.message
          : "診断できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。",
      );
    }
  }
  const surname = type === "surname";
  const readings = surname ? [] : getReadingOptions(name, gender);
  const needsReading =
    !surname && (/\p{Script=Han}/u.test(name) || readings.length > 1);
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="glass form-card">
      <div className="form-heading">
        <span className="mini-star">✳</span>
      </div>
      <h2>世界のあなたに、会いにいこう。</h2>
      <p className="muted">まずは、何を診断しますか？</p>
      <div className="tabs" aria-label="診断の種類">
        {(["given_name", "surname"] as const).map((t) => (
          <button
            type="button"
            key={t}
            aria-pressed={type === t}
            className={type === t ? "selected" : ""}
            onClick={() => {
              setType(t);
              setError("");
            }}
          >
            {t === "given_name" ? "下の名前" : "苗字"}{" "}
            <span>{type === t ? "↗" : ""}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <label className="field-label" htmlFor="name">
        あなたの{surname ? "苗字" : "名前"}
        <span>漢字・ひらがな・カタカナ・英字</span>
      </label>
      <input
        id="name"
        name="name"
        value={name}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setName(e.target.value);
          setReading("");
          setError("");
        }}
        placeholder={surname ? "例：佐藤" : "例：はると"}
        maxLength={30}
        autoComplete="off"
        required
        aria-describedby={error ? "form-error" : undefined}
      />
      <div className="examples">
        試してみる：
        {(surname
          ? ["佐藤", "鈴木", "山田"]
          : ["じゅん", "れん", "さくら"]
        ).map((n) => (
          <button
            key={n}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setName(n);
              setReading("");
              if (n === "ゆい" || n === "さくら") setGender("female");
              else if (!surname) setGender("male");
              setError("");
            }}
          >
            {n}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {needsReading && (
        <div className="reading-field">
          <label className="field-label" htmlFor="reading">
            名前の読み方
          </label>
          <input
            id="reading"
            list="reading-options"
            placeholder="例：はると（候補からも選べます）"
            value={reading}
            maxLength={30}
            onChange={(e) => setReading(e.target.value)}
          />
          <datalist id="reading-options">
            {readings.map((r) => (
              <option key={r} value={r} />
            ))}
          </datalist>
        </div>
      )}
      {!surname && (
        <fieldset>
          <legend className="field-label">ランキングの性別</legend>
          <div className="gender-options">
            {(["male", "female"] as const).map((g) => (
              <label key={g}>
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="gender"
                  value={g}
                  checked={gender === g}
                  onChange={() => {
                    setGender(g);
                    setReading("");
                  }}
                />
                <span>{g === "male" ? "男性" : "女性"}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p id="form-error" role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <button className="primary" type="submit">
        世界の{surname ? "苗字" : "名前"}を見る <span>↗</span>
      </button>
      <p className="form-caption">Same popularity. Different country.</p>
    </form>
  );
}
export function Results() {
  const { result } = useContext(ResultContext);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  if (!result)
    return (
      <main className="empty glass">
        <span className="eyebrow">YOUR NEXT JOURNEY</span>
        <h1>
          世界の名前を
          <br />
          見つけよう。
        </h1>
        <p>結果は再読み込みすると消えます。もう一度診断してください。</p>
        <Link className="primary" href="/">
          診断をはじめる ↗
        </Link>
      </main>
    );
  async function action(kind: "save" | "share") {
    if (!result) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      setStatus(
        await (kind === "save" ? saveResult(result) : shareResult(result)),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus(
        e instanceof Error && e.name === "AbortError"
          ? "共有をキャンセルしました。"
          : "処理できませんでした。画像保存をもう一度お試しください。",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <main className="results">
      <div className="result-heading">
        <span className="eyebrow">YOUR PARALLEL NAME</span>
        <h1>世界には、こんなあなたがいる。</h1>
      </div>
      {result.autoDetectedFrom && (
        <p className="mode-notice" role="status">
          「{result.input.name}」は下の名前の対象ランキングになく、苗字データに一致したため、苗字として診断しました。
        </p>
      )}
      <section className="glass original">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">
            YOUR {result.input.type === "surname" ? "SURNAME" : "NAME"} · JAPAN{" "}
            <Flag code="JP" label="日本" />
          </span>
          <h2>{result.input.name}</h2>
          <p>
            {result.input.type === "given_name"
              ? `${result.input.gender === "male" ? "男性" : "女性"} · `
              : ""}
            {result.record?.isEstimated
              ? "公開ランキングの掲載傾向から推定"
              : result.meta.dataYear
                ? `${result.meta.dataYear}年の調査を使用`
              : "調査年度不明のデータを使用"}
            {result.input.reading ? ` · 読み：${result.input.reading}` : ""}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="rank">
          <span>
            日本での人気度{" "}
            <small>
              {result.meta.isSample
                ? "サンプル"
                : result.record?.rankingBasis === "overall"
                  ? result.record.isEstimated
                    ? "総合推定順位"
                    : "読み方順位"
                : result.record?.rankingBasis === "spelling"
                  ? "漢字表記順位"
                  : result.record?.rankingBasis === "reading"
                    ? "読み方順位"
                    : "調査内順位"}
            </small>
          </span>
          <strong>
            {result.record
              ? `#${result.record.rank}`
              : result.recognition === "dictionary"
                ? "公開順位なし"
                : "データ未収録"}
          </strong>
          <small>
            {result.record
              ? `${result.record.totalEntries.toLocaleString("ja-JP")}件の中での順位`
              : result.recognition === "dictionary"
                ? "名前辞書には収録されています"
                : "入力表記・読みをご確認ください"}
          </small>
        </div>
        <div className="rarity">
          <span>
            Rarity Score <small>推定</small>
          </span>
          <b>
            {result.record ? result.score : "—"}
            <small>{result.record ? " / 100" : " 算出不可"}</small>
          </b>
          <div className="meter">
            <span style={{ width: `${result.record ? result.score : 0}%` }} />
          </div>
          <small>一般的 ← → 珍しい</small>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="result-subtitle">
        <h2>
          もし
          {result.input.type === "surname"
            ? "海外の苗字だったら"
            : "海外で生まれていたら"}
          …
        </h2>
        <span>IF YOU WERE BORN IN…</span>
      </div>
      <div className="match-grid">
        {result.matches.map(({ country, record }, i) => (
          <article
            className="glass match-card"
            key={country.code}
            style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 65}ms` }}
          >
            <div className="match-top">
              <span className="flag">
                <Flag code={country.code} label={country.nameJa} />
              </span>
              <span>
                {country.nameEn}
                <small>{country.nameJa}</small>
              </span>
              <span className="match-index">0{i + 1}</span>
            </div>
            <h3>{record.name}</h3>
            <div className="match-bottom">
              <span>
                現地ランキング <b>#{record.rank}</b>
              </span>
              <span>
                {result.record
                  ? record.rank === result.record.rank
                    ? "日本と同じ順位"
                    : "収録範囲内の近い順位"
                  : "参考候補"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="match-source">
              {record.year ? `${record.year}年 · ` : ""}
              {getCountryConfig(country.code) &&
              result.matches.find((m) => m.country.code === country.code)?.meta
                .isSample
                ? "サンプル"
                : "公開データ"}
            </p>
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="result-actions">
        <button
          className="primary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => action("save")}
        >
          ↓ 結果を画像保存
        </button>
        <button
          className="secondary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => action("share")}
        >
          ↗ シェア
        </button>
        <Link className="again" href="/">
          もう一度診断 ↻
        </Link>
      </div>
      <p className="status" role="status">
        {status || "ストーリーにぴったりの9:16画像で保存できます。"}
      </p>
      <details className="data-details">
        <summary>
          診断のしくみ・データについて <span>＋</span>
        </summary>
        <p>
          日本の下の名前は、ベビーカレンダーの2017年以降の名前ランキング検索と明治安田の名前調査を使用します。公開順位がある読みは最新の実順位を表示し、未掲載の読みは公開ランキングへの掲載実績、一般名辞書への収録、漢字表記数から総合順位を推定します。日本の苗字は公開辞書の推定人数順です。海外の下の名前と苗字は各国の公開ランキングから取得できる範囲を使用します。
        </p>
        <p>
          海外の下の名前は各国の公開ランキングから取得できる範囲を収録し、日本の順位番号と同じ順位を優先して対応させます。同数順位は掲載順を連番化しています。国ごとの収録上限を超える場合は収録範囲内で最も近い順位を表示します。Rarity
          Scoreは日本側の順位に基づく補助値です。
        </p>
        <p>
          名前辞書は男性5,578読み・女性3,294読み、苗字は1,999件を収録しています。辞書にある下の名前には推定順位を付けるため、一般的な名前から少し珍しい名前まで診断できます。漢字に複数の読みがある場合は入力時に選択できます。
        </p>
        {[result.meta, ...result.matches.map((m) => m.meta)].map((meta) => (
          <p key={meta.country}>
            {getCountryConfig(meta.country)[0]?.nameJa}：
            {meta.sourceUrl ? (
              <a href={meta.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                {meta.source} ↗
              </a>
            ) : (
              meta.source
            )}{" "}
            / {meta.dataYear || "年度不明"} /{" "}
            {meta.isSample ? "サンプル" : "公開データ"}
          </p>
        ))}
        <p>
          入力情報はメモリ内だけで処理し、サーバー・外部AIへ送信しません。シェア操作をした場合のみ、選択した共有先に結果を渡します。
        </p>
      </details>
    </main>
  );
}

import datasets from "@/data/registry.json";
import countries from "@/data/countries.json";
import dictionary from "@/data/dictionary/names.json";
import type {
  CountryConfig,
  Dataset,
  Diagnosis,
  DiagnosisInput,
  MatchingMode,
  NameRecord,
  NameType,
  RankingBasis,
} from "./types";
export const normalizeName = (name: string) =>
  name
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[ァ-ヶ]/g, (c) => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) - 96));
const readingIndex = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
for (const entry of dictionary)
  for (const alias of [entry.reading, ...entry.aliases]) {
    const key = `${entry.gender}|${normalizeName(alias)}`;
    if (!readingIndex.has(key)) readingIndex.set(key, new Set());
    readingIndex.get(key)!.add(entry.reading);
  }
export function getReadingOptions(
  name: string,
  gender: string = "male",
): string[] {
  return [
    ...(readingIndex.get(`${gender}|${normalizeName(name)}`) ?? []),
  ].sort();
}
export function getCountryConfig(code?: string): CountryConfig[] {
  return countries.filter((c) => c.enabled && (!code || c.code === code));
}
export function getDataset(country: string, type: NameType): Dataset {
  const d = (datasets as Dataset[]).find(
    (d) => d.meta.country === country && d.meta.type === type,
  );
  if (!d) throw Error("対応データがありません");
  return d;
}
export function getDatasetMetadata(
  country: string,
  type: NameType,
  year?: number,
) {
  const d = getDataset(country, type);
  return { ...d.meta, dataYear: year ?? d.meta.dataYear };
}
export function getCohort(
  input: DiagnosisInput,
  country: string,
  rankingBasis?: RankingBasis,
): NameRecord[] {
  const inferredRankingBasis =
    rankingBasis ??
    (country === "JP" && input.type === "given_name"
      ? "overall"
      : undefined);
  const records = getDataset(country, input.type).records.filter(
    (record) =>
      (input.type === "surname" || record.gender === input.gender) &&
      (!inferredRankingBasis ||
        record.rankingBasis === inferredRankingBasis),
  );
  if (input.type === "surname" || inferredRankingBasis === "overall")
    return records;
  const years = [
    ...new Set(
      records.map((r) => r.year).filter((y): y is number => y !== undefined),
    ),
  ];
  const year = years.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Math.abs(a - (input.year ?? a)) - Math.abs(b - (input.year ?? b)) ||
      b - a,
  )[0];
  return records.filter((r) => r.year === year);
}

function findJapaneseGivenNameRecord(
  input: DiagnosisInput,
): NameRecord | undefined {
  const normalizedName = normalizeName(input.name);
  const options = getReadingOptions(input.name, input.gender);
  const reading = input.reading
    ? normalizeName(input.reading)
    : options.length === 1
      ? options[0]
      : normalizedName;
  return getDataset("JP", "given_name").records.find(
    (record) =>
      record.gender === input.gender &&
      record.rankingBasis === "overall" &&
      normalizeName(record.name) === reading,
  );
}

export function getNameRecord(
  input: DiagnosisInput,
  country = "JP",
): NameRecord | undefined {
  if (country === "JP" && input.type === "given_name")
    return findJapaneseGivenNameRecord(input);

  const normalized = normalizeName(input.name);
  const matchesReading = (r: NameRecord) =>
    [r.name, ...(r.aliases ?? [])].some(
      (alias) => normalizeName(alias) === normalized,
    );
  const cohortRecord = getCohort(input, country).find(matchesReading);
  return cohortRecord;
}
export const getSurnameRecord = (name: string, country = "JP") =>
  getNameRecord({ name, type: "surname" }, country);
export function calculateRankPercentile(rank: number, totalEntries: number) {
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(rank) ||
    !Number.isFinite(totalEntries) ||
    rank < 1 ||
    totalEntries < rank
  )
    throw Error("ランキングの範囲が不正です");
  return rank / totalEntries;
}
export const calculateRarityScore = (record?: NameRecord) =>
  record
    ? Math.round(
        calculateRankPercentile(record.rank, record.totalEntries) * 100,
      )
    : 97;
export function hash(value: string) {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (const c of value) h = Math.imul(h ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return h >>> 0;
}
export function findClosestEquivalentName(
  input: DiagnosisInput,
  country: string,
  source?: NameRecord,
  mode: MatchingMode = "exactRank",
): NameRecord {
  const records = getCohort(input, country);
  if (!records.length) throw Error("該当するデータがありません");
  if (!source) {
    const tail = [...records]
      .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank)
      .slice(-Math.max(1, Math.ceil(records.length * 0.2)));
    return tail[
      hash(
        `${normalizeName(input.reading ?? input.name)}|${input.year ?? ""}|${input.gender ?? ""}|${country}`,
      ) % tail.length
    ];
  }
  const distance = (r: NameRecord) => {
    if (mode === "populationShare") {
      if (source.share === undefined || r.share === undefined)
        throw Error("人数割合のデータが不足しています");
      return Math.abs(source.share - r.share);
    }
    return mode === "exactRank"
      ? Math.abs(source.rank - r.rank)
      : Math.abs(
          calculateRankPercentile(source.rank, source.totalEntries) -
            calculateRankPercentile(r.rank, r.totalEntries),
        );
  };
  return records.reduce((best, r) =>
    distance(r) < distance(best) ||
    (distance(r) === distance(best) && r.rank < best.rank)
      ? r
      : best,
  );
}
export const findClosestEquivalentSurname = (
  name: string,
  country: string,
  source?: NameRecord,
  mode?: MatchingMode,
) =>
  findClosestEquivalentName({ name, type: "surname" }, country, source, mode);
export function validateInput(input: DiagnosisInput): string | undefined {
  if (!["given_name", "surname"].includes(input.type))
    return "診断の種類を選んでください。";
  if (!input.name.trim()) return "名前を入力してください。";
  if (
    Array.from(input.name.trim()).length > 30 ||
    !/^[\p{L}\p{M}ー・ '’-]+$/u.test(input.name.trim())
  )
    return "名前は30文字以内の漢字・かな・英字で入力してください。";
  if (
    input.type === "given_name" &&
    !["male", "female"].includes(input.gender ?? "")
  )
    return "性別を選んでください。";
  if (input.type === "given_name") {
    const readings = getReadingOptions(input.name, input.gender);
    if (
      readings.length > 1 &&
      !input.reading &&
      !/^[ぁ-ゖー]+$/.test(normalizeName(input.name))
    )
      return "名前の読み方を選んでください。";
    if (
      input.reading &&
      (!/^[ぁ-ゖー]+$/.test(normalizeName(input.reading)) ||
        input.reading.length > 30)
    )
      return "読み方は30文字以内のひらがな・カタカナで入力してください。";
  }
}
export function diagnose(input: DiagnosisInput): Diagnosis {
  const error = validateInput(input);
  if (error) throw Error(error);
  const clean: DiagnosisInput =
    input.type === "surname"
      ? { name: input.name.trim(), type: input.type }
      : { ...input, name: input.name.trim() };
  const record = getNameRecord(clean);
  const sourceYear = record?.year ?? getCohort(clean, "JP")[0]?.year;
  const recognition = record
    ? clean.type === "given_name" &&
      record.rankingBasis !== "overall" &&
      record.year !== clean.year
      ? "historical"
      : "ranked"
    : clean.type === "given_name" &&
        getReadingOptions(clean.name, clean.gender).length > 0
      ? "dictionary"
      : "unrecognized";
  return {
    input: clean,
    record,
    score: calculateRarityScore(record),
    recognition,
    meta: getDatasetMetadata("JP", input.type, sourceYear),
    matches: getCountryConfig()
      .filter(
        (c) =>
          c.code !== "JP" &&
          (input.type === "surname" ? c.supportsSurname : c.supportsGivenName),
      )
      .map((country) => {
        const record = findClosestEquivalentName(
          clean,
          country.code,
          getNameRecord(clean),
        );
        return {
          country,
          record,
          meta: getDatasetMetadata(country.code, input.type, record.year),
        };
      }),
  };
}

import type { Diagnosis } from './types';
export async function createResultImage(result: Diagnosis): Promise<Blob> {
 await document.fonts.ready;
 const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=1080;canvas.height=1920;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)throw new Error('画像を生成できません');
 ctx.fillStyle='#101212';ctx.fillRect(0,0,1080,1920);
 const flags = new Map<string,HTMLImageElement>();
 await Promise.all(['JP',...result.matches.map(m=>m.country.code)].map(async code=>{const img=new Image();img.src=`/flags/${code}.svg`;await img.decode();flags.set(code,img);}));
 const text=(value:string,x:number,y:number,size:number,color='#f5f6ee',width=900)=>{ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.font=`600 ${size}px Arial, "Yu Gothic", sans-serif`;while(ctx.measureText(value).width>width&&size>12){size-=2;ctx.font=`600 ${size}px Arial, "Yu Gothic", sans-serif`;}ctx.fillText(value,x,y);};
 const rankingLabel=result.record?.rankingBasis==='overall'?(result.record.isEstimated?'総合推定順位':'読み方順位'):result.record?.rankingBasis==='spelling'?'漢字表記順位':result.record?.rankingBasis==='reading'?'読み方順位':'日本ランキング';
 const dataLabel=result.record?.isEstimated?'公開傾向から推定':result.meta.dataYear?`${result.meta.dataYear}年調査`:'年度不明';

 download(blob);return 'このブラウザーでは直接共有できないため、共有用画像を保存しました。';
}

## src/lib/types.ts

```
export type NameType = "given_name" | "surname";
export type Gender = "male" | "female" | "unknown";
export type MatchingMode = "exactRank" | "normalizedRank" | "populationShare";
export type RankingBasis = "reading" | "spelling" | "overall";
export type NameRecord = {
  country: string;
  type: NameType;
  name: string;
  aliases?: string[];
  rank: number;
  totalEntries: number;
  year?: number;
  gender?: Gender;
  count?: number;
  share?: number;
  dataYear?: number;
  rankingBasis?: RankingBasis;
  isEstimated?: boolean;
};
export type DatasetMeta = {
  country: string;
  type: NameType;
  source: string;
  sourceUrl?: string;
  dataYear: number;
  isOfficial: boolean;
  isSample: boolean;
  notes?: string;
};
export type Dataset = { meta: DatasetMeta; records: NameRecord[] };
export type CountryConfig = {
  code: string;
  nameJa: string;
  nameEn: string;
  flag: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  supportsGivenName: boolean;
  supportsSurname: boolean;
};
export type DiagnosisInput = {
  name: string;
  type: NameType;
  gender?: Gender;
  year?: number;
  reading?: string;
};
export type Diagnosis = {
  input: DiagnosisInput;
  record?: NameRecord;
  score: number;
  recognition: "ranked" | "historical" | "dictionary" | "unrecognized";
  autoDetectedFrom?: NameType;
  matches: { country: CountryConfig; record: NameRecord; meta: DatasetMeta }[];
  meta: DatasetMeta;
};

## scripts/build-data-registry.mjs

```
import { readdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const root='src/data';
const files=[];
function walk(dir){for(const item of readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const path=join(dir,item.name);if(item.isDirectory())walk(path);else if(item.name.endsWith('.json'))files.push(path);}}
for(const dir of readdirSync(root,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()&&d.name!=='dictionary'))walk(join(root,dir.name));
const datasets=files.sort().map(f=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(f,'utf8')));
const seen=new Set();
for(const d of datasets){const key=`${d.meta.country}/${d.meta.type}`;if(seen.has(key))throw Error(`Duplicate dataset: ${key}`);seen.add(key);if(!d.records.length)throw Error(`Empty dataset: ${key}`);for(const r of d.records){if(r.rank<1||r.rank>r.totalEntries)throw Error(`Invalid rank: ${r.name}`);}}
writeFileSync(join(root,'registry.json'),JSON.stringify(datasets,null,2)+'\n');
console.log(`Registered ${datasets.length} datasets.`);

## scripts/import-baby-calendar.mjs

```
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const output = "data-sources/rankings/jp-baby-calendar.json";
const base = "https://baby-calendar.jp/nazuke/result";
const sleep = (milliseconds) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));

function readingsFrom(file) {
  return readFileSync(file, "utf8")
    .trim()
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((line) => line.split(",")[0]);
}

function existingReadings(sex) {
  const values = [];
  for (let year = 2004; year <= 2025; year += 1) {
    const file = `data-sources/rankings/jp-${year}.json`;
    if (!existsSync(file)) continue;
    for (const row of JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"))) {
      if (row.sex === sex) values.push(toHiragana(row.yomi));
    }
  }
  return values;
}

function toHiragana(value) {
  return value
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .replace(/[ァ-ヶ]/g, (character) =>
      String.fromCharCode(character.charCodeAt(0) - 96),
    );
}

function parseRows(html, reading, sex) {
  const rows = [];
  const pattern =
    /<tr>\s*<td>(\d{4})<\/td>\s*<td><span[^>]*>(\d+)<\/span>位\s*／\s*(\d+)位中/gu;
  for (const match of html.matchAll(pattern)) {
    rows.push({
      reading,
      sex,
      year: Number(match[1]),
      rank: Number(match[2]),
      totalEntries: Number(match[3]),
    });
  }
  return rows;
}

async function fetchRanking(reading, sex) {
  const gender = sex === "m" ? 1 : 2;
  const url = `${base}?mode=kana&gender=${gender}&kana=${encodeURIComponent(reading)}`;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt += 1) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        headers: {
          "user-agent":
            "NAMAE data importer (+https://github.com/eido0916/NAMED)",
        },
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw Error(`${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
      return parseRows(await response.text(), reading, sex);
    } catch (error) {
      if (attempt === 3) throw error;
      await sleep(400 * attempt);
    }
  }
}

const groups = [
  {
    sex: "m",
    names: [
      ...readingsFrom(
        "data-sources/japanese-names/first_name_man_opti.csv",
      ),
      ...existingReadings("m"),
      "じゅん",
      "じゅんや",
      "れん",
      "れんや",
    ],
  },
  {
    sex: "f",
    names: [
      ...readingsFrom(
        "data-sources/japanese-names/first_name_woman_opti.csv",
      ),
      ...existingReadings("f"),
    ],
  },
];

const records = [];
for (const group of groups) {
  const names = [...new Set(group.names)].sort((a, b) =>
    a.localeCompare(b, "ja"),
  );
  for (let start = 0; start < names.length; start += 6) {
    const batch = names.slice(start, start + 6);
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batch.map((name) => fetchRanking(name, group.sex)),
    );
    records.push(...results.flat());
    process.stdout.write(
      `\r${group.sex}: ${Math.min(start + batch.length, names.length)}/${names.length}`,
    );
    await sleep(180);
  }
  process.stdout.write("\n");
}

records.sort(
  (a, b) =>
    a.sex.localeCompare(b.sex) ||
    a.reading.localeCompare(b.reading, "ja") ||
    b.year - a.year,
);
writeFileSync(
  output,
  `${JSON.stringify(
    {
      source: "ベビーカレンダー 名前ランキング検索",
      sourceUrl: "https://baby-calendar.jp/nazuke/",
      retrievedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      records,
    },
    null,
    2,
  )}\n`,
);
console.log(`Saved ${records.length} ranking rows to ${output}.`);

```

## scripts/import-foreign-rankings.mjs

```
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import JSZip from "jszip";
import ExcelJS from "exceljs";

const cacheDir = "data-sources/rankings/foreign";
mkdirSync(cacheDir, { recursive: true });
const limit = 2000;

async function download(url, file) {
  if (existsSync(file)) return readFileSync(file);
  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { "user-agent": "NAMED data importer" } });
  if (!response.ok) throw Error(`${response.status} ${url}`);
  const body = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
  writeFileSync(file, body);
  return body;
}

function record(country, gender, name, rank, year, count) {
  return { country, type: "given_name", name, rank, totalEntries: 0, gender, year, dataYear: year, ...(count === undefined ? {} : { count }) };
}

function finalize(records) {
  for (const gender of ["male", "female"]) {
    const group = records.filter((item) => item.gender === gender);
    group.forEach((item, index) => { item.rank = index + 1; item.totalEntries = group.length; });
  }
  return records;
}

async function importUnitedKingdom() {
  const base = "https://www.ons.gov.uk/file?uri=/peoplepopulationandcommunity/birthsdeathsandmarriages/livebirths/datasets/babynamesenglandandwalesbabynamesstatistics";
  const files = { male: `${base}boys/2025/2025boysbabynames.xlsx`, female: `${base}girls/2025/2025girlsbabynames.xlsx` };
  const records = [];
  for (const [gender, url] of Object.entries(files)) {
    const body = await download(url, join(cacheDir, `gb-${gender}.xlsx`));
    const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
    await workbook.xlsx.load(body);
    const sheet = workbook.worksheets.find((item) => /top|name|rank/i.test(item.name)) ?? workbook.worksheets[0];
    const rows = [];
    sheet.eachRow((row) => rows.push(row.values.map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim())));
    let header = rows.findIndex((row) => row.some((value) => /name/i.test(value)) && row.some((value) => /rank/i.test(value)));
    if (header < 0) header = 0;
    const nameColumn = rows[header].findIndex((value) => /name/i.test(value));
    const rankColumn = rows[header].findIndex((value) => /rank/i.test(value));
    const countColumn = rows[header].findIndex((value) => /count|number/i.test(value));
    for (const row of rows.slice(header + 1)) {
      const name = row[nameColumn];
      const rank = Number(String(row[rankColumn] ?? "").replace(/[, ]/g, ""));
      if (!name || !Number.isFinite(rank) || rank < 1) continue;
      if (rank <= limit) records.push(record("GB", gender, name, rank, 2025, countColumn >= 0 ? Number(row[countColumn]) || undefined : undefined));
    }
  }
  const broad = await download(
    "https://github.com/onomaverse/datasets/releases/download/v2026.06/given-name-frequency.csv",
    join(cacheDir, "onomaverse-given-name-frequency.csv"),
  );
  const seen = new Set(records.map((item) => `${item.gender}|${item.name.toLowerCase()}`));
  const additions = { male: [], female: [] };
  for (const line of broad.toString("utf8").split(/\r?\n/).slice(1)) {
    const fields = line.split(",");
    if (fields.length < 8 || fields[3] !== "GB") continue;
    const name = fields[0].trim();
    if (!name) continue;
    const genders = fields[2].includes("M") ? ["male"] : [];
    if (fields[2].includes("F")) genders.push("female");
    for (const gender of genders) {
      const key = `${gender}|${name.toLowerCase()}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      additions[gender].push({ name, count: Number(fields[5]) || 0 });
    }
  }
  for (const gender of ["male", "female"]) {
    additions[gender].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    const current = records.filter((item) => item.gender === gender);
    additions[gender].forEach((item, index) => records.push(record("GB", gender, item.name, current.length + index + 1, 2025, item.count)));
  }
  return finalize(records);
}

async function importFrance() {
  const url = "https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/fichier/8894961/prenoms-2024-nat_csv.zip";
  const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await download(url, join(cacheDir, "fr-2024.zip")));
  const csvEntry = Object.values(zip.files).find((entry) => entry.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".csv"));
  if (!csvEntry) throw Error("INSEE CSV not found in archive");
  const text = await csvEntry.async("string");
  const rows = text.split(/\r?\n/).slice(1).map((line) => line.split(";"));
  const byGender = new Map([["1", []], ["2", []]]);
  for (const [sex, name, year, count] of rows) {
    if (year !== "2024" || !name || !byGender.has(sex)) continue;
    byGender.get(sex).push({ name, count: Number(count) || 0 });
  }
  const records = [];
  for (const [sex, values] of byGender) {
    values.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "fr"));
    values.slice(0, limit).forEach((value, index) => records.push(record("FR", sex === "1" ? "male" : "female", value.name, index + 1, 2024, value.count)));
  }
  return finalize(records);
}

function parseGermanList(html, index) {
  const table = html.match(/<!--Hitliste Beginn-->([\s\S]*?)<!--Hitliste Ende-->/i)?.[1] ?? "";
  const lists = [...table.matchAll(/<ol>([\s\S]*?)<\/ol>/gi)].map((match) =>
    [...match[1].matchAll(/<li[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/li>/gi)].map((match) =>
      match[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").replace(/&uuml;/g, "ü").replace(/&amp;/g, "&").trim(),
    ).filter(Boolean),
  );
  return lists[index]?.slice(0, limit) ?? [];
}

async function importGermany() {
  const url = "https://www.beliebte-vornamen.de/jahrgang/j2024/top-500-2024";
  const html = await (await fetch(url, { headers: { "user-agent": "NAMED data importer" } })).text();
  const female = parseGermanList(html, 0);
  const male = parseGermanList(html, 1);
  const records = [
    ...male.map((name, index) => record("DE", "male", name, index + 1, 2024)),
    ...female.map((name, index) => record("DE", "female", name, index + 1, 2024)),
  ];
  const broad = readFileSync(join(cacheDir, "onomaverse-given-name-frequency.csv"), "utf8");
  const seen = new Set(records.map((item) => `${item.gender}|${item.name.toLowerCase()}`));
  for (const line of broad.split(/\r?\n/).slice(1)) {
    const fields = line.split(",");
    if (fields.length < 8 || fields[3] !== "DE") continue;
    const genders = fields[2].includes("M") ? ["male"] : [];
    if (fields[2].includes("F")) genders.push("female");
    for (const gender of genders) {
      const name = fields[0].trim();
      const key = `${gender}|${name.toLowerCase()}`;
      if (!name || seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      records.push(record("DE", gender, name, 0, 2024, Number(fields[5]) || undefined));
    }
  }
  return finalize(records);
}

async function importKorea() {
  const records = [];
  for (let page = 1; page <= 20; page += 1) {
    const url = `https://baby-name.kr/annalRanking/2024/${page === 1 ? "" : `${page}/`}`;
    const html = await (await fetch(url, { headers: { "user-agent": "NAMED data importer" } })).text();
    const tables = [...html.matchAll(/<div class="half-table">([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/gi)].map((match) => match[1]);
    if (tables.length < 2) continue;
    for (const [gender, table] of [["male", tables[0]], ["female", tables[1]]]) {
      for (const row of table.matchAll(/<tr[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<td[^>]*>\s*(\d+)[\s\S]*?<\/td>[\s\S]*?<td[^>]*>\s*<a[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>[\s\S]*?<td[^>]*>\s*([\d,]+)/gi)) {
        records.push({ country: "KR", type: "given_name", name: row[2].trim(), rank: 0, totalEntries: limit, gender, year: 2024, dataYear: 2024, count: Number(row[3].replace(/,/g, "")), sourceRank: Number(row[1]) });
      }
    }
  }
  const normalized = [];
  for (const gender of ["male", "female"]) {
    const seen = new Set();
    records.filter((item) => item.gender === gender).forEach((item) => {
      if (seen.has(item.name) || seen.size >= limit) return;
      seen.add(item.name);
      normalized.push({ ...item, rank: seen.size });
    });
  }
  return finalize(normalized);
}

const all = [await importUnitedKingdom(), await importFrance(), await importGermany(), await importKorea()];
for (const records of all) {
  if (!records.length) throw Error("Foreign ranking is empty");
  const country = records[0].country.toLowerCase();
  writeFileSync(join(cacheDir, `${country}-${records[0].year}.json`), JSON.stringify(records));
}
console.log(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(all.flat().reduce((map, row) => map.set(row.country, (map.get(row.country) ?? 0) + 1), new Map()))));

import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";

const cacheDir = "data-sources/rankings/foreign";
mkdirSync(cacheDir, { recursive: true });

async function download(url, file) {
  if (existsSync(file)) return readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { "user-agent": "NAMED data importer" } });
  if (!response.ok) throw Error(`${response.status} ${url}`);
  const text = await response.text();
  writeFileSync(file, text);
  return text;
}

function makeRecords(country, values, year) {
  values.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  const totalEntries = values.length;
  return values.map((value, index) => ({
    country,
    type: "surname",
    name: value.name,
    aliases: value.aliases ?? [],
    rank: index + 1,
    totalEntries,
    count: value.count,
    year,
    dataYear: year,
  }));
}

const csv = await download(
  "https://github.com/onomaverse/datasets/releases/download/v2026.06/surname-frequency.csv",
  join(cacheDir, "onomaverse-surname-frequency.csv"),
);
const countryNames = { US: "United States", GB: "United Kingdom", FR: "France", DE: "Germany", KR: "South Korea" };
const values = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(countryNames).map((code) => [code, []]));
for (const line of csv.split(/\r?\n/).slice(1)) {
  const fields = line.split(",");
  if (fields.length < 6 || !values[fields[2]]) continue;
  const name = fields[0].trim();
  if (name) values[fields[2]].push({ name, count: Number(fields[4]) || 0 });
}

const koreanHtml = await (await fetch("https://koreanlastnames.com/most-common-korean-last-names/", { headers: { "user-agent": "NAMED data importer" } })).text();
for (const row of koreanHtml.matchAll(/<tr[^>]*>\s*<td[^>]*data-v="(\d+)"[^>]*>\d+<\/td>\s*<td[^>]*data-v="([^"]+)"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<a[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>[\s\S]*?<\/td>\s*<td[^>]*class="kln-hg"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/td>/gi)) {
  const count = Number(row[1]);
  const name = row[3].trim();
  const hangul = row[4].trim();
  if (name) values.KR.push({ name, aliases: [hangul], count });
}
for (const [country, year] of [["US", 2020], ["GB", 2025], ["FR", 2024], ["DE", 2024], ["KR", 2015]]) {
  const records = makeRecords(country, values[country], year);
  if (!records.length) throw Error(`${country} surname ranking is empty`);
  writeFileSync(join(cacheDir, `${country.toLowerCase()}-surname-${year}.json`), JSON.stringify(records));
  console.log(`${country}: ${records.length}`);
}

## scripts/import-name-data.mjs

```
import {
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from "node:fs";

const cache = "data-sources/rankings";
mkdirSync(cache, { recursive: true });

const hira = (value) =>
  value
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .replace(/[ァ-ヶ]/g, (character) =>
      String.fromCharCode(character.charCodeAt(0) - 96),
    );

const dictionary = [];
const commonReadings = new Set();
for (const [gender, file] of [
  ["male", "man"],
  ["female", "woman"],
]) {
  for (const line of readFileSync(
    `data-sources/japanese-names/first_name_${file}_org.csv`,
    "utf8",
  )
    .trim()
    .split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const [reading, romaji, ...kanji] = line.split(",");
    dictionary.push({
      gender,
      reading,
      aliases: [romaji, ...kanji].filter(Boolean),
    });
  }
  for (const line of readFileSync(
    `data-sources/japanese-names/first_name_${file}_opti.csv`,
    "utf8",
  )
    .trim()
    .split(/\r?\n/)) {
    commonReadings.add(`${gender}|${line.split(",")[0]}`);
  }
}
mkdirSync("src/data/dictionary", { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(
  "src/data/dictionary/names.json",
  JSON.stringify(dictionary),
);

const japanese = [];
const american = [];
const readingYears = [];
const spellingYears = [];

async function cached(url, file) {
  if (existsSync(file)) return readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) throw Error(`${response.status} ${url}`);
  const text = await response.text();
  writeFileSync(file, text);
  return text;
}

function importJapaneseRows(rows, year, rankingBasis) {
  for (const row of rows) {
    const gender = row.sex === "m" ? "male" : "female";
    const totalEntries = rows.filter((item) => item.sex === row.sex).length;
    japanese.push({
      country: "JP",
      type: "given_name",
      name: rankingBasis === "reading" ? hira(row.yomi) : row.name,
      rank: Number(row.rank),
      totalEntries,
      year,
      dataYear: year,
      gender,
      count: Number(row.count),
      share: row.per === undefined ? undefined : Number(row.per),
      rankingBasis,
    });
  }
}

for (let start = 1920; start <= 2025; start += 4) {
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: Math.min(4, 2026 - start) }, (_, index) =>
      start + index,
    ).map(async (year) => {
      try {
        const rows = JSON.parse(
          await cached(
            `https://www.meijiyasuda.co.jp/enjoy/ranking/assets/json/n_${year}.json`,
            `${cache}/jp-spelling-${year}.json`,
          ),
        );
        importJapaneseRows(rows, year, "spelling");
        spellingYears.push(year);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(`JP spelling ${year}: ${error.message}`);
      }

      if (year >= 2004) {
        try {
          const rows = JSON.parse(
            await cached(
              `https://www.meijiyasuda.co.jp/enjoy/ranking/assets/json/y_${year}.json`,
              `${cache}/jp-${year}.json`,
            ),
          );
          importJapaneseRows(rows, year, "reading");
          readingYears.push(year);
        } catch (error) {
          console.log(`JP reading ${year}: ${error.message}`);
        }
      }

      if (year >= 1989 && year <= 2020) {
        try {
          const rows = (
            await cached(
              `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hackerb9/ssa-baby-names/main/raw-data/yob${year}.txt`,
              `${cache}/us-${year}.txt`,
            )
          )
            .trim()
            .split(/\r?\n/)
            .map((line) => line.split(","));
          for (const sex of ["M", "F"]) {
            const group = rows.filter((row) => row[1] === sex);
            group.slice(0, 5000).forEach(([name, , count], index) =>
              american.push({
                country: "US",
                type: "given_name",
                name,
                rank: index + 1,
                totalEntries: Math.min(5000, group.length),
                year,
                dataYear: year,
                gender: sex === "M" ? "male" : "female",
                count: Number(count),
              }),
            );
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.log(`US ${year}: ${error.message}`);
        }
      }
    }),
  );
}

function addJapaneseOverallRankings() {
  const published = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync("data-sources/rankings/jp-baby-calendar.json", "utf8"),
  );
  const latestPublished = new Map();
  for (const row of published.records) {
    const gender = row.sex === "m" ? "male" : "female";
    const key = `${gender}|${row.reading}`;
    const current = latestPublished.get(key);
    if (!current || row.year > current.year) latestPublished.set(key, row);
  }

  const spellingReadings = new Map();
  for (const entry of dictionary) {
    for (const alias of entry.aliases.slice(1)) {
      const key = `${entry.gender}|${alias}`;
      if (!spellingReadings.has(key)) spellingReadings.set(key, new Set());
      spellingReadings.get(key).add(entry.reading);
    }
  }

  const evidence = new Map();
  const addEvidence = (key, value) =>
    evidence.set(key, (evidence.get(key) ?? 0) + value);
  for (const record of japanese) {
    const key = `${record.gender}|${record.name}`;
    const recency = Math.exp(-(2025 - record.year) / 24);
    const position =
      (record.totalEntries - record.rank + 1) / record.totalEntries;
    if (record.rankingBasis === "reading") {
      addEvidence(key, 10 * recency * position);
      continue;
    }
    const candidates = spellingReadings.get(key);
    if (candidates?.size === 1) {
      addEvidence(
        `${record.gender}|${[...candidates][0]}`,
        1.5 * recency * position,
      );
    }
  }

  for (const gender of ["male", "female"]) {
    const candidates = dictionary
      .filter((entry) => entry.gender === gender)
      .map((entry) => {
        const key = `${gender}|${entry.reading}`;
        const survey = latestPublished.get(key);
        const surveyScore = survey
          ? 1000 * (1 - survey.rank / survey.totalEntries)
          : 0;
        return {
          entry,
          survey,
          score:
            surveyScore +
            (evidence.get(key) ?? 0) +
            (commonReadings.has(key) ? 0.6 : 0) +
            Math.log1p(entry.aliases.length - 1) * 0.015,
        };
      })
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          b.score - a.score ||
          b.entry.aliases.length - a.entry.aliases.length ||
          a.entry.reading.localeCompare(b.entry.reading, "ja"),
      );

    candidates.forEach(({ entry, survey }, index) => {
      japanese.push({
        country: "JP",
        type: "given_name",
        name: entry.reading,
        rank: survey?.rank ?? index + 1,
        totalEntries: survey?.totalEntries ?? candidates.length,
        year: survey?.year,
        dataYear: survey?.year ?? 2025,
        gender,
        rankingBasis: "overall",
        isEstimated: !survey,
      });
    });
  }
}

addJapaneseOverallRankings();

if (!japanese.length || !american.length) throw Error("No rankings imported");

const japaneseForApp = japanese.filter(
  (record) => record.rankingBasis === "overall",
);
const americanForApp = american.filter((record) => record.year === 2020);

const sortRecords = (a, b) =>
  (a.year ?? 0) - (b.year ?? 0) ||
  String(a.gender).localeCompare(String(b.gender)) ||
  String(a.rankingBasis).localeCompare(String(b.rankingBasis)) ||
  a.rank - b.rank ||
  a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ja");
japaneseForApp.sort(sortRecords);
americanForApp.sort(sortRecords);

const foreignDatasets = [
  {
    country: "GB",
    year: 2025,
    source: "Office for National Statistics・Onomaverse Global Given-Name Frequency",
    sourceUrl: "https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/birthsdeathsandmarriages/livebirths/datasets/babynamesenglandandwalesbabynamesstatisticsboys",
    file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/gb-2025.json",
  },
  {

    source: "INSEE Fichier des prénoms national",
    sourceUrl: "https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8894961",
    file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/fr-2024.json",

  {

    sourceUrl: "https://www.beliebte-vornamen.de/jahrgang/j2024/top-500-2024",

  {

    sourceUrl: "https://baby-name.kr/annalRanking/2024/",
    file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/kr-2024.json",
  },
];
for (const dataset of foreignDatasets) {
  const records = JSON.parse(readFileSync(dataset.file, "utf8"));
  const normalized = records.map((record) => ({
    ...record,
    totalEntries: record.totalEntries || records.filter((item) => item.gender === record.gender).length,

  writeFileSync(

        isSample: false,

      },
      records: normalized,
    }),
  );
}

const foreignSurnameDatasets = [
  { country: "US", year: 2020, source: "Onomaverse Global Surname Frequency", sourceUrl: "https://onomaverse.com/datasets/surname-frequency", file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/us-surname-2020.json" },
  { country: "GB", year: 2025, source: "Onomaverse Global Surname Frequency", sourceUrl: "https://onomaverse.com/datasets/surname-frequency", file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/gb-surname-2025.json" },
  { country: "FR", year: 2024, source: "Onomaverse Global Surname Frequency", sourceUrl: "https://onomaverse.com/datasets/surname-frequency", file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/fr-surname-2024.json" },
  { country: "DE", year: 2024, source: "Onomaverse Global Surname Frequency", sourceUrl: "https://onomaverse.com/datasets/surname-frequency", file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/de-surname-2024.json" },
  { country: "KR", year: 2015, source: "Korean Last Names・2015 Census / Onomaverse", sourceUrl: "https://koreanlastnames.com/most-common-korean-last-names/", file: "data-sources/rankings/foreign/kr-surname-2015.json" },
];
for (const dataset of foreignSurnameDatasets) {
  const records = JSON.parse(readFileSync(dataset.file, "utf8"));
  writeFileSync(

    }),

}

const meta = (country, source, sourceUrl, records) => ({

      : "SSA公開データのミラーを使用。2020年の男女別上位5,000件を収録。",
});

writeFileSync(

## scripts/serve.mjs

```
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { readFile,stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve,extname,sep } from 'node:path';
const root=resolve('out');
const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.ico':'image/x-icon','.txt':'text/plain; charset=utf-8','.woff2':'font/woff2'};
createServer(async(req,res)=>{try{let path=resolve(root,'.'+decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url,'http://localhost').pathname));if(path!==root&&!path.startsWith(root+sep)){res.writeHead(403).end();return;}if((await stat(path)).isDirectory())path=resolve(path,'index.html');const data=await readFile(path);res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[extname(path)]??(path.endsWith('opengraph-image')?'image/png':'application/octet-stream')});res.end(data);}catch{res.writeHead(404,{'Content-Type':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'}).end('Not found');}}).listen(Number(process.env.PORT||3000),'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log(`NAMAE: http://localhost:${process.env.PORT||3000}`));

  await page.locator("#name").fill("はやし");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "世界の名前を見る" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("苗字として診断しました。", { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator(".rank strong")).toHaveText("#18");
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
  expect(
    await page.evaluate(
      () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
    ),
  ).toBe(true);
  await page.reload();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("link", { name: "診断をはじめる" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto("http://localhost:3000");
  expect(
    await page.evaluate(
      () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
    ),
  ).toBe(true);
});

```

## tests/engine.test.ts

```
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  diagnose,
  calculateRankPercentile,
  findClosestEquivalentName,
  getNameRecord,
  getSurnameRecord,
  getReadingOptions,
  validateInput,
  getCohort,
} from "../src/lib/engine";

test("deep Japanese rankings cover the reported ordinary names", () => {
  const cases = [
    ["じゅん", 365],
    ["れん", 31],
    ["じゅんや", 638],
    ["れんや", 259],
  ] as const;
  for (const [name, rank] of cases) {
    const result = diagnose({ name, type: "given_name", gender: "male" });
    assert.equal(result.record?.rank, rank);
    assert.equal(result.record?.totalEntries, 1981);
    assert.equal(result.record?.year, 2025);
    assert.equal(result.record?.rankingBasis, "overall");
    assert.equal(result.record?.isEstimated, false);
    assert.equal(result.recognition, "ranked");
  }
});

test("given-name diagnosis no longer requires a birth year", () => {
  assert.equal(
    validateInput({ name: "じゅん", type: "given_name", gender: "male" }),
    undefined,
  );
  assert.equal(
    getCohort(
      { name: "じゅん", type: "given_name", gender: "male" },
      "JP",
    ).length,
    5578,
  );
});

test("foreign names use the same published rank number", () => {
  const result = diagnose({
    name: "じゅん",
    type: "given_name",
    gender: "male",
  });
  assert.equal(result.record?.rank, 365);
  for (const match of result.matches) assert.equal(match.record.rank, 365);
});

test("foreign rankings remain available beyond the former 500-name cutoff", () => {
  const result = diagnose({ name: "じゅんや", type: "given_name", gender: "male" });
  assert.equal(result.record?.rank, 638);
  for (const match of result.matches) assert.equal(match.record.rank, 638);
});

test("normalization mode remains available explicitly", () => {
  assert.equal(calculateRankPercentile(100, 5000), 0.02);
  const source = {
    country: "JP",
    type: "given_name" as const,
    name: "test",
    gender: "male" as const,
    rank: 10,
    totalEntries: 50,
  };
  const result = findClosestEquivalentName(
    { name: "test", type: "given_name", gender: "male" },
    "US",
    source,
    "normalizedRank",
  );
  assert.equal(result.rank, 1000);
});

test("dictionary-only names receive a clearly marked estimated rank", () => {
  const result = diagnose({
    name: "ああす",
    type: "given_name",
    gender: "male",
  });
  assert.ok(result.record);
  assert.equal(result.record?.rankingBasis, "overall");
  assert.equal(result.record?.isEstimated, true);
  assert.equal(result.recognition, "ranked");
});

test("kanji and romanized input resolve through the reading dictionary", () => {
  assert.ok(getReadingOptions("純也").includes("じゅんや"));
  assert.ok(getReadingOptions("JUN").includes("じゅん"));
  assert.equal(
    getNameRecord({
      name: "純也",
      reading: "じゅんや",
      type: "given_name",
      gender: "male",
    })?.rank,
    638,
  );
  assert.equal(
    getNameRecord({ name: "JUN", type: "given_name", gender: "male" })?.rank,
    365,
  );
});

test("Hayashi is recognized as a surname", () => {
  const surname = getSurnameRecord("はやし");
  assert.equal(surname?.name, "林");
  assert.equal(surname?.rank, 18);
  assert.equal(getSurnameRecord("林")?.rank, 18);
  assert.equal(getCohort({ name: "佐藤", type: "surname" }, "JP").length, 1999);
});

test("foreign surnames use the same rank number", () => {
  const result = diagnose({ name: "はやし", type: "surname" });
  assert.equal(result.record?.rank, 18);
  for (const match of result.matches) assert.equal(match.record.rank, 18);
});

test("ambiguous kanji readings require explicit selection", () => {
  const options = getReadingOptions("大翔");
  assert.ok(options.length > 1);
  assert.match(
    validateInput({ name: "大翔", type: "given_name", gender: "male" }) ?? "",
    /読み方/,
  );
  const result = diagnose({
    name: "大翔",
    reading: "はると",
    type: "given_name",
    gender: "male",
  });
  assert.equal(result.record?.rankingBasis, "overall");
});

test("unknown input is deterministic and surname strips extra fields", () => {
  const input = {
    name: "未収録名",
    type: "given_name" as const,
    gender: "male" as const,
  };
  assert.deepEqual(diagnose(input), diagnose(input));
  assert.equal(diagnose(input).record, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(
    diagnose({ name: "佐藤", type: "surname", year: 2009, gender: "male" })
      .input,
    { name: "佐藤", type: "surname" },
  );
});

test("invalid inputs are rejected", () => {
  assert.ok(validateInput({ name: " ", type: "surname" }));
  assert.ok(validateInput({ name: "123", type: "surname" }));
  assert.ok(validateInput({ name: "あ".repeat(31), type: "surname" }));
  assert.ok(validateInput({ name: "じゅん", type: "given_name" }));
  assert.throws(() => calculateRankPercentile(0, 10));
});

```

## README.md

```
# NAMAE

名前・苗字のランキングから海外名を探すNext.js / TypeScript / Tailwind CSSアプリです。入力情報はブラウザーのメモリ内のみで処理します。

## 起動

```sh
npm ci
npm run dev
```

http://localhost:3000 を開きます。PowerShellで実行ポリシーによりnpmが起動できない場合は `npm.cmd` を使用してください。`npm run build` で静的な `out/` を生成し、`npm start` でその成果物を配信できます。

## 今回の修正

- 生まれ年を必須入力から外し、現在の人気度を基準に診断する形へ変更。
- ベビーカレンダーの深い読み順位を追加。「じゅん」「れん」「じゅんや」「れんや」など、従来の上位50件では拾えなかった名前にも実順位を表示。
- 日本の名前辞書8,872読みすべてに総合順位レコードを用意。公開順位がない名前は、公開ランキング掲載歴・一般名辞書への収録・漢字表記数を使った推定順位として区別して表示。
- 日本の順位番号をそのまま優先し、各国の公開ランキングから取得できる範囲で同じ順位の海外名を選択。
- 下の名前モードで「はやし」などの苗字に一致した場合は、自動で苗字診断へ切り替えて案内。
- 漢字名に複数の読みがある場合は読みを確認。かな・カタカナ・ローマ字からも照合可能。

## 収録範囲と出典

| データ | 件数・年度 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| 日本の総合人気順位 | 男女合計8,872読み（実順位888読み、推定順位7,984読み） | 現在の診断に使用 |
| 日本の深い読み順位 | 2017〜2025年、延べ6,478レコード | 公開検索結果。各読みの最新順位を総合人気順位で優先 |
| 日本の名前辞書 | 男性5,578読み・女性3,294読み、漢字・ローマ字の別表記付き | 入力照合と未掲載名の推定 |
| 日本の漢字表記ランキング | 1920〜2025年、延べ6,863レコード（1,123表記） | 推定順位の掲載実績に使用 |
| 日本の読み方ランキング | 2004〜2025年、延べ2,290レコード | 推定順位の掲載実績に使用 |
| 日本の苗字 | 1,999姓、調査年度不明 | 辞書内の推定人数を降順で順位付け |
| 米国の下の名前 | 2020年、男女各5,000件 | SSA人数順。人数同数は元ファイル順（アルファベット順） |
| 英・仏・韓・独の下の名前 | 英1,554件・仏4,000件・韓4,000件・独1,828件（2024〜2025年） | ONS / INSEE / 韓国出生届集計 / ドイツTop500・補完データ。海外カードの順位対応に使用 |
| 海外の苗字 | 米1,925・英864・仏947・韓106・独393姓 | Onomaverse姓氏頻度。韓国は2015年国勢調査Top100を補完。日本の順位番号に対応 |

日本の実順位は[ベビーカレンダーの名前ランキング検索](https://baby-calendar.jp/nazuke/)が公開する2017年以降の読み順位を使用し、検索対象に含まれた888読みは最新掲載年の順位を表示します。補助情報には[明治安田の生まれ年別の名前調査](https://www.meijiyasuda.co.jp/enjoy/ranking/index.html)の漢字表記・読み方ランキングを使います。各調査の対象者内の順位であり、全国民の人口順位ではありません。

米国は[SSA](https://www.ssa.gov/oact/babynames/limits.html)の公開データを[hackerb9のミラー](https://github.com/hackerb9/ssa-baby-names)から取得しました。現在は2020年までの収録です。

英国の上位100件は[英国国家統計局（ONS）](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/birthsdeathsandmarriages/livebirths/datasets/babynamesenglandandwalesbabynamesstatisticsgirls)、順位補完には[Onomaverse](https://onomaverse.com/datasets/given-name-frequency)（CC BY 4.0）を使用しています。フランスは[INSEE](https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8894961)、ドイツは[Beliebte Vornamen Top 500](https://www.beliebte-vornamen.de/jahrgang/j2024/top-500-2024)、韓国は[아기이름の2024年出生届順位](https://baby-name.kr/annalRanking/2024/)を使用しています。

海外の苗字は[Onomaverse Global Surname Frequency](https://onomaverse.com/datasets/surname-frequency)を使用し、韓国は[2015年国勢調査に基づく韓国姓氏Top100](https://koreanlastnames.com/most-common-korean-last-names/)を補完しています。

辞書・苗字は[Japanese Personal Name Dataset](https://github.com/shuheilocale/japanese-personal-name-dataset)（MIT）です。原典とライセンスを `data-sources/japanese-names/` に保存しています。公開順位のない読みでは、同データセットの一般名リストへの収録と別表記数を弱い補助信号として使います。苗字の人数は推定値であり、全国公式統計として扱いません。

## アルゴリズム

`src/lib/engine.ts` にUIから分離しています。既定の `exactRank` は日本の順位番号と同じ順位を海外名から選びます。同数順位は掲載順を連番化しています。国ごとの収録上限を超える入力には、収録範囲内で最も近い順位を表示します。`normalizedRank` と `populationShare` も明示指定で利用可能です。

Rarity Scoreは順位/同じ性別の収録件数×100を四捨五入します。人口割合ではありません。辞書にもない入力は順位を断定せず、海外の下位20%から入力条件のハッシュによる一定の参考候補を選びます。

かな・ローマ字は読みへ正規化します。漢字の読みが一意でない場合は利用者に確認し、選ばれた読みの総合人気順位を表示します。公開検索に最新実順位がある場合はそれを優先し、ない場合だけ推定順位を使用します。

## データ更新

`src/data/<国>/<種別>/*.json` にデータセットを配置し、`src/data/countries.json` に国設定を追加します。1国・1種別につき1データセットで、records内に複数年度を格納できます。

```sh
node scripts/import-name-data.mjs
npm run data:build
```

通常のデータ生成とビルドはネットワーク取得せず、同梱データからregistryを再生成します。海外ランキングを更新するときは `npm run data:refresh:foreign` と `node scripts/import-foreign-surnames.mjs`、日本の公開検索結果を更新するときは `npm run data:refresh:baby-calendar` を実行し、その後に上記2コマンドを実行します。従来の `generate-sample-data.mjs` は全データを初期サンプルに戻すため、通常運用では実行しないでください。

## 検証

```sh
npm test
npm run lint
npm run build
# 開発サーバー起動中・Chromeインストール済み環境で:
npm run test:browser
```

テストは対象4名の実順位、生年なしの診断、日本と海外の順位番号一致、辞書推定順位、漢字・ローマ字対応、苗字対応、読み確認、未収録の再現性を確認します。共有先への実投稿は行いません。

## 公開・画像・プライバシー

`NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` に本番URLを設定してビルドしてください。Vercelまたは静的ホスティングで配信できます。DB・外部AI API・解析サービスは不要です。

結果は1080×1920 PNGで保存できます。共有はWeb Share APIを使い、非対応時はコピーまたは画像保存にフォールバックします。国旗はTwemoji（CC BY 4.0）。`public/flags/` にライセンスと出典を保存しています。

入力情報をURL・Cookie・localStorage・サーバーに保存しません。再読み込みすると結果は消えます。利用者が共有操作をした場合のみ共有先に結果を渡します。

`node scripts/export-source.mjs` で全ソースを `SOURCE.md` に出力できます。

```
